train_decoder_model: train a YZFormer or baseline Transformer decoder model on WikiText2 or WikiText103 datasets
evaluate_decoder_model: evaluate a trained decoder model on validation data and compute perplexity and attention entropy
batchify_data: divide a flat token tensor into batched sequences for training a language model
get_batch: extract a data-target pair from batched source tensor for a single training step
get_model_stats: compute validation loss, perplexity, and attention statistics for a trained decoder model
